$doc.what: Durable registry of livestream-repurpose batches for the whole social-media repo. One object per batch; persists for finished (archived) batches too. Paths are relative to this file's directory (the repo root).
consumers: cleanup/cleanup.js (video-creation target) — protects ACTIVE batches' directories; treats everything else as recyclable.
scripts/reconcile-batch-status.js — recomputes each batch's `status` (active|completed) from the queues' batch field; the authority on status, run before cleanup.
repurpose/SKILL.md — reads transcript_plain of the next batch whose pipelines.repurpose is 'pending'.
scripts/publish-shorts.py — (future) batch -> render folder + shorts.json source.

status_values.active: current batch still in progress; its directories/files are protected from cleanup.
status_values.completed: fully published (every queued short AND long posted everywhere, repurpose done); its directories/files are eligible for cleanup. This is COMPUTED, not hand-set — run `node scripts/reconcile-batch-status.js` (it derives status from schedule-tweets/data/{shorts,longs}.json via each item's batch field). Do not edit status by hand. EXCEPTION: a batch published outside the queues (e.g. a longform uploaded manually, never staged to longs.json) can't be derived — set `manual_status: "completed"` on it and the reconciler honors that verbatim instead of deriving.
status_values.archived: legacy synonym for completed (pre-reconciler); still honoured by cleanup as eligible. New reconciler runs write 'completed'.

pipelines.shorts: video-creation side: cut clips -> render shorts (active | done).
pipelines.repurpose: tweet/image side (repurpose/ skill): pending | done. The skill sets this to done after generating.
pipelines.longform: longform-presentation side: render spotlight presentation -> stage to schedule-tweets longs.json (pending | done).

$doc.note: Older publishing batches exist in schedule-tweets/data/shorts.json (weekend-red-2026-05-24, remotion-2026-05-25) but predate this registry and have no retained video-creation source artifacts, so they are not listed here. Going forward, every new batch should keep its files under per-batch folders (remotion/out/<batch>/, shorts/<batch>-clips/, assets/<batch>/) so 'directories' can list them cleanly. Per-batch generated assets (b-roll, overlays, rendered clips) go under assets/projects/<batch>/ — see video-creation/SKILL.md 'Asset folder organization'.

track_values.longform-presentation: a longform-presentation project (slide deck + presenter), built in video-creation/longform-presentation/
track_values.longform-edited: a heavily-edited longform project (b-roll/music/motion-graphics, NOT slide-deck), built in video-creation/longform-edited/; Phase 4 style guide grows per video
